b: Yesterday, my wife’s [39F] laptop screen started getting lines down it, so I tried to copy her files onto a portable SSD in case we needed to get it repaired or replaced.

About a third of the screen wasn’t working, so I was having trouble seeing the files. I clicked on the iCloud folder in Finder and saw a folder called “Downloads 2”, which I mistook for one of the regular folders I was backing up. Inside were four folders and a zip file. The four folders had the same name with different numbers at the end. The zip file had a different name, but all five had the same contents.

I had a quick look to see what needed backing up. There was over 1 GB of photos, videos and WhatsApp conversations between her and her ex. About 80% of it was explicit. There were toys, outfits, porn (BBC) and their “adventures”. What I saw made me feel sick. I felt like I was looking at a side of her I didn’t know at all.

I knew she’d kept some files from her ex to prove they’d been in a relationship because she got a restraining order against him. Long story short, they dated for two years, and he was cheating on her with another woman for pretty much the whole time. She found out by following him one day. He tried to get her back, threatened to kill himself, staged a fake attempt and started stalking her. That’s her side of the story, and I believed it at the time.

We started dating six months later. I thought things were really good at first. We had a lot of the same interests (cycling, hiking, photography and travel), spent every waking moment together, and I thought the sex was good. She said she had PTSD from her previous relationship, and she’d monitor everywhere I went. It was hard to even go out with friends without her blowing up and accusing me of cheating or being disrespectful. I think I went out without her maybe three times in our first year.

We’ve been together for five years now. We’re married and have a child who’s nearly two. Over the last two years, our sex life has dwindled to the point where I’m lucky if we have sex once a month. I’ve resorted to watching porn or rereading old messages between us to satisfy myself, though only occasionally. Twice, she caught me with porn links open on my phone. She absolutely blew up, told me how disgusting I was, asked why I’d need that in a relationship and said I was just like every other man. She says she hates men, except for me. She also actively checks my social media to see who I'm friends with and questions any girls, she also made me delete all my exes photos from social media.

I feel like I’ve tried everything to improve things. I listen more, I don’t debate things, and I’ve tried hugging and kissing her, but she never really shows any interest back. It just feels forced. I get so sick of being rejected that I end up giving up.

When I brought up what I’d found on her laptop, her first response was to ask why I was going through her personal stuff. She started yelling and calling me sick. I told her I was trying to help and was looking through the files to see what needed copying.

I asked why she’d kept so much explicit stuff for a domestic violence order (DVO) when she could’ve kept a few photos and conversations. She said she didn’t want to look through it, so she’d kept everything. I asked if she’d handed all of it to the police. She said she’d put together a summary with pictures and text for them. That made no sense to me. If she’d already gone through it to put together a summary, why keep everything else?

I’d checked the dates and saw that the zip file was created before we started dating, but the four folders were created two years into our relationship. I asked why she’d extracted it if she didn’t want to look at it. She said she must have tapped the zip file by accident on her iPhone while trying to free up space in iCloud. I said it had been extracted four times, which to me suggested she was trying to see what was in it. She kept saying, “You know what I’m like with computers. I would’ve done it by accident.”

It felt like she was playing dumb. She uses a computer for work, uses AI to control her applications and knows how files work. I pointed out that the folders had a different name from the zip file, so I thought she must have changed the name while extracting the files/folders. I felt like she kept brushing off what I was saying and trying to explain it away with irrelevant evidence. I got mad and walked off.

She spent the next hour getting ChatGPT to go through her texts and Facebook messages to build a timeline. She came back with a “report” and said the folders were created the day she got her phone fixed. I said iCloud doesn’t unzip and rename files for you. I also asked if that was the day she threw her phone at me and I left her place and said we were over. I’d left for a day or so because I wasn’t going to put up with having things thrown at me.

She didn’t answer that and said she’d been talking to a friend, so why would she have been looking at the photos? I said the two things were an hour apart, and I had no idea what she was doing at home by herself.

I checked the files again to see when they’d last been opened, but none of them showed a date, including the ones I’d opened. I figured that was because they were in iCloud. The folders did show they’d last been modified a few months ago.

She spent the next four hours trying to prove me wrong, but she couldn’t. After she gave up, she sent me this text; "Sorry, I didn’t think you liked me wearing these types of outfits. I would have worn them more if I had known. You are just upset because I had another sexual relationship." - I didn’t respond.

It’s been 12 hours and we’ve barely said a word to each other. I honestly can’t even look at her. She made me feel like a complete sicko and a degenerate for looking at porn, and all this time she had this stuff saved. I honestly don’t know what to do next. We have a child we both love so much, but things have already been rocky for two years, and I don’t know if I can come back from this.

To be clear for all the snooping accusations and why didn't I just copy the whole drive. Its simple really, we didn't have enough space left of the portable SSD to copy everything off the laptop including the system files. So I picked the main folders such as documents, downloads, videos and copied them straight across without even looking. I then saw 'downloads 2' folder which looked like a duplicate, so I checked to see if its the same content and it wasn't. She asked me to do it it all for her.
